results.sql: WITH latest_submission AS (SELECT claim_key, service_month FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission), primary_payer AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key, payer_class FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'), current_primary_adjudication AS (SELECT primary_payer.claim_key, primary_payer.payer_class, latest_submission.service_month, COALESCE(remit_claims.paid_amount, 0) AS paid_amount FROM primary_payer JOIN latest_submission ON latest_submission.claim_key = primary_payer.claim_key JOIN sem.remit_claims AS remit_claims ON remit_claims.claim_key = primary_payer.claim_key AND remit_claims.payer_key = primary_payer.payer_key AND remit_claims.is_current_adjudication WHERE latest_submission.service_month IN (DATE '2026-06-01', DATE '2026-07-01')) SELECT payer_class, SUM(CASE WHEN service_month = DATE '2026-06-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS june_claim_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN service_month = DATE '2026-06-01' THEN paid_amount END), 2) AS june_avg_paid, SUM(CASE WHEN service_month = DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS july_claim_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN service_month = DATE '2026-07-01' THEN paid_amount END), 2) AS july_avg_paid, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN service_month = DATE '2026-07-01' THEN paid_amount END) - AVG(CASE WHEN service_month = DATE '2026-06-01' THEN paid_amount END), 2) AS change_july_minus_june FROM current_primary_adjudication GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

results.sql: WITH prim AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key, payer_class FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P'), lat AS (SELECT claim_key, service_month FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission), c AS (SELECT prim.payer_class, lat.service_month m, r.paid_amount FROM prim JOIN lat USING(claim_key) JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key=prim.claim_key AND r.payer_key=prim.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication WHERE lat.service_month IN (DATE '2026-06-01', DATE '2026-07-01')), a AS (SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m=DATE '2026-06-01') jn, AVG(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE m=DATE '2026-06-01') ja, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m=DATE '2026-07-01') yn, AVG(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE m=DATE '2026-07-01') ya FROM c GROUP BY 1) SELECT payer_class, jn june_claim_count, ROUND(ja,2) june_avg_paid, yn july_claim_count, ROUND(ya,2) july_avg_paid, ROUND(ya-ja,2) change FROM a ORDER BY 1

results.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payer_class, service_month, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date DESC, claim_id DESC) rn FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility='P'), pl AS (SELECT * FROM p WHERE rn=1), cur AS (SELECT claim_key, payer_key, SUM(paid_amount) paid FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication GROUP BY 1,2), agg AS (SELECT pl.payer_class, SUM(CASE WHEN service_month=DATE '2026-06-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) june_claim_count, AVG(CASE WHEN service_month=DATE '2026-06-01' THEN paid END) ja, SUM(CASE WHEN service_month=DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) july_claim_count, AVG(CASE WHEN service_month=DATE '2026-07-01' THEN paid END) ya FROM pl JOIN cur USING (claim_key, payer_key) GROUP BY 1) SELECT payer_class, june_claim_count, ROUND(ja,2) AS june_average_paid, july_claim_count, ROUND(ya,2) AS july_average_paid, ROUND(ya-ja,2) AS change_july_minus_june FROM agg ORDER BY payer_class
